name: Emily Clarke
headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Full-stack engineer with 5 years shipping JavaScript and TypeScript services and web apps for payments and retail. Comfortable from the database schema to the last pixel of the checkout page.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Split the merchant monolith into nine Node.js microservices written in TypeScript, each owning its own PostgreSQL schema.
Built the refunds service on Express.js, handling 40,000 refunds a day with idempotent retries.
Packaged every service with Docker and cut local environment setup from a day to 20 minutes.
Own the React merchant dashboard used by 6,000 small businesses to track payouts.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Built React storefronts and a Node.js order service for three fashion retailers.
Designed REST APIs over MongoDB for product catalogues of up to 50,000 items.
Wrote Jest tests for the shared JavaScript component library and the checkout flow.
